claves: Glóbulos rojos fragmentados. Se ven sobre todo en la hemólisis intravascular, la insuficiencia renal y la púrpura trombocitopénica trombótica (PTT).

imagen.descripcionOriginal: Schistocytes (fragmented red cells) are red cells fragmented. They are seen commonly in blood film of patients with intravascular haemolysis, renal failure and thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura (TTP).
